provenance.purpose: Explicit, reviewed disposition for every baseline tool not directly provided under the same name. Enforced by test/parity.test.ts — a missing entry fails the gate.

taxonomy.mapped: provided by the plugin under a different tool id (e.g. site-declared `site_*`)
taxonomy.not-applicable: page-host application internals / host-agent loops that are out of scope for a generic cross-site browser extension consumer
taxonomy.delegated: the page/site remains the owner; the plugin neither reimplements nor exposes it
taxonomy.pending-permission: implementable, but requires a NEW extension permission — reported, NOT implemented this round
taxonomy.baseline-disabled: the original assistant registered it as disabled; not part of the exposed command surface then or now

lgdl-web-cli.reason: LGDL graph content tool is provided as a site-declared tool via the page RPC (17 subcommands), not a plugin built-in.

lgdl-web-op-cli.reason: LGDL UI operations are provided as a site-declared tool via the page RPC (19 subcommands).

storage.reason: Page-host application KV storage is the site's own concern; the plugin uses chrome.storage internally and intentionally never exposes it to the LLM.
storage.basis: spec.md FR-022 (O-002 通用消费端定位); docs/capability-matrix.md #6

storage-quota.reason: Same as storage — page-host storage quota probing is out of scope for the extension consumer.

settings.reason: Plugin configuration lives in the extension options page + key-store; there is no page-level settings tool to mirror.

doc-read.reason: Document reading is a site-declared capability (get-node/doc-info) in the generic model, not an extension built-in.

doc-edit.reason: Editor write-back is the site's apply/onApply path exposed via the declared tool surface (FR-020), not a plugin built-in.

session.reason: The page-host session store is replaced by the plugin's own multi-session store (per-origin/group) — see session-store.ts; it is not an LLM tool.

context.reason: Context budget/compaction is a host-agent loop concern handled by the upstream truncation path, not an exposed browser tool.

search-content.reason: In-page content search is a site-declared capability; the generic consumer has no page-index to search.

list-resources.reason: Resource listing is a site-declared capability with no generic extension equivalent.

todo.reason: Host-agent task list — a single-turn host-loop concern, not a browser capability the extension should expose.

goal.reason: Host-agent goal tracking — a host-loop concern, not a browser capability.

jobs.reason: Host-agent background jobs — a host-loop concern, not a browser capability.

notify.reason: chrome.notifications requires the `notifications` permission, which is not in the manifest. Per the no-silent-permission-expansion red line this round, it is reported only — NOT implemented.
notify.basis: spec.md FR-006 / FR-022; task constraint 权限纪律

clipboard.reason: Background clipboard access needs clipboardRead/clipboardWrite; the extension currently holds neither. Reported only — NOT implemented.
clipboard.basis: spec.md FR-006 / FR-028; task constraint 权限纪律

eval-js.reason: The original assistant registered eval-js as disabled (enabled:false); it was never part of the exposed command list. The plugin likewise does not offer arbitrary worker JS eval.

subagent.reason: Registered disabled in the baseline (single-session P0); not part of the exposed command list.

page-eval.reason: Registered disabled in the baseline (evaluate highest tier); the plugin keeps the evaluate tier absent/fail-closed.

cookie.reason: Registered disabled in the baseline (site-owned cookies); the plugin does not touch cross-origin cookies.

dialog.reason: Registered disabled in the baseline (native dialog override is a page-world capability); not exposed.

net.reason: Registered disabled in the baseline (network interception); exposing it would need webRequest/DNR and is out of scope.

admin_origin-revoke.reason: Plugin management tool — revoke per-origin authorization.

admin_origin-list.reason: Plugin management tool — list authorized origins.

admin_descriptor-show.reason: Plugin management tool — inspect the active site declaration.

admin_audit-export.reason: Plugin management tool — export the audit trail.

admin_llm-config.reason: Plugin management tool — masked LLM configuration.

tabs.reason: Plugin-level tab management tool (list/switch/open; no close).
